vocabulary.definition: an imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect
vocabulary.example: The concept of uploading our minds into a digital utopia seems possible.

vocabulary.definition: supposed but not necessarily real or true
vocabulary.example: Dream mind uploading is the hypothetical concept of transferring the mind into a computer.

vocabulary.definition: the philosophical position that everything is physical or is dependent on physical processes
vocabulary.example: The idea that everything about the mind can be found in the brain is called physicalism.

vocabulary.definition: based on or adapted to a theory of probability
vocabulary.example: One approach to simulating the brain could involve using probabilistic models.

vocabulary.definition: the ability to live forever; eternal life
vocabulary.example: Successful mind uploading could lead to functional immortality.

vocabulary.definition: the state of being aware of and able to think about one's surroundings
vocabulary.example: Mind uploading raises questions about whether digital consciousness is the same as biological consciousness.
